notes: Fiscal year ended December 31, 2024 (matches data.js fy 'Dec 2024'). Sources: FY2024 Form 10-K (accession 0001099590-25-000007), 2025 proxy statement (DEF 14A, accession 0001099590-25-000020), and the Schedule 13D/A on the Galperin Trust (accession 0001437749-24-033000, filed November 1, 2024), all read on EDGAR. LEADER: the proxy shows Marcos Galperin directly owning just 35 shares (marked *, less than 1%), received in a distribution from Kaszek Ventures. GALPERIN TRUST: the proxy lists 'Galperin Trust' separately at 3,550,136 shares (7.00%) and does not attribute it to Marcos Galperin. The 13D/A describes Galperin Trust /SD only as 'an irrevocable trust formed under the laws of South Dakota and was established for the benefit of certain individuals and certain charitable organizations', restructured 'in the context of estate planning transactions', with Corpag Trust South Dakota Inc. as trustee. The earlier Schedule 13D (filed May 24, 2024; accession 0001437749-24-018325) and Schedule 13G/A (filed July 1, 2024; accession 0001437749-24-021748) were also read on EDGAR. None of these documents names the beneficiaries or links the trust to Marcos Galperin or his family. It is therefore listed as a holder of type 'other', not as his stake or as a family holding, and not added to his figure. HOLDERS: Baillie Gifford's 13G/A filing date (November 4, 2024) is given, not its as-of date, so asOf is null. BUYBACKS: the cash-flow line shows $1 million of repurchases in 2024 (versus $356 million in 2023), recorded as 0.001 billion rather than rounded to 0.00 so it is not shown as zero. STOCK COMP: null. The 10-K says no stock options were granted from 2007 through 2024 and there was no stock-option expense from 2019 through 2024; employee long-term pay is the cash-settled LTRP, under which certain employees receive cash payments over six years, half of the target award varying with the share price; in 2024 the company paid $160 million of LTRP ($61 million fixed, $99 million variable). Because it is a cash bonus for certain employees rather than stock, workers.plan is null. The cash-flow statement shows 'Long term retention program (“LTRP”) accrued compensation 261' ($ millions, 2024), but that accrual includes the fixed cash portion, so it is not recorded as share-based compensation. GEOGRAPHY: segment revenues are from external customers and sum to the $20,777 million total.

ecosystem.notes: The two volumes overlap. TPV includes marketplace transactions paid with Mercado Pago, so TPV and GMV must never be added. platformRevenue is Commerce services revenues ($10.076B), which leaves out first-party product sales ($2.083B). It still includes classifieds fees and ad sales, while GMV excludes Classifieds, so services revenue divided by GMV slightly overstates the marketplace take. Total commerce revenues were $12.159B, and total net revenues and financial income were $20.777B (Fintech $8.618B, which includes credit revenues). secondaryMeasure is a schema extension for TPV.
